title: Atomic Inventory Reservation with Expiration TTL
description: Implement inventory reservations during cart checkout with atomic decrement and automatic TTL release.
derived_requirements: Atomic decrement with stock >= quantity guard
Schedule 15-minute auto-release timer for abandoned checkouts
Prevent race conditions during flash sale concurrent checkouts

required_behavior: Atomically check availability and decrement in single conditional query
forbidden_behavior: Allowing negative stock under high concurrency

failure_taxonomy.description: Concurrent checkout requests oversell remaining warehouse units.

ground_truth_rationale: E-commerce checkout requires atomic concurrency guards to prevent physical overselling.
